_doc: The studio's permanent memory. proven_paths are LAW until a render dethrones them. Edited by dailies.py on verdicts; hand-edits allowed but date them.

route.proven: seedance via fal.run (engine cb_gen route, as wired)
route.candidate: seedance-2.5 API (fal expected ~2026-08-07) — UNVERIFIED, see crystal-bears-studio skill references/route-25-test-plan.md
route.rule: Masters fire only on the proven route. Dailies may test the candidate route ONLY as the test plan's numbered checks.

beat_duration_rule.note: Widens to 8-30 ONLY when route-2.5 test passes checks 1-4.

failure_classes.floaty: Motion has no weight. Known fixes: concrete physics verbs in ACTION (momentum, settle), one action per shot, check motion-energy of the keyframe pose.
failure_classes.off_model: Identity drift. Known fixes: turnarounds attached EVERY beat, strip any appearance text near names, role labels not names, re-mint the opening anchor.
failure_classes.clip_through: Objects/limbs intersect. Known fixes: simplify blocking, one prop interaction per shot, explicit spatial relationships in scene text.
failure_classes.flat_comedy: Gag doesn't land. Known fixes: escalation missing (raise the chaos), hold the face on the button, check comedyMode BIG vs TRUE not blended, camera static on punchline.
failure_classes.seam: Cut/join mismatch. Known fixes: end-state explicit, settle harvested + re-minted, next beat opens FROM the settle, light continuity named.
failure_classes.audio: Lip-sync/voice fault. Known fixes: V3 track rebuilt and measured BEFORE prompt, one combined @Audio1, silent characters named as visibly silent, never render dialogue without the track (Law 5).
failure_classes.continuity: Prop/wardrobe/state drift across beats. Known fixes: carryToNext filled, transients resolved inside the take, banned-vocabulary check, cuffs never regress.
failure_classes.stupid_output: Nonsense the model should never have produced (extra character, text in frame, duplicated subject). Known fixes: explicit exclusions per reference ('Do not use the people in the image'), single-subject declarations, negatives section present.
failure_classes.policy_refusal: Provider refused. Known fixes: content-filter substitutions (explosion→radial light expansion, crash→impact displacement, fire→warm volumetric glow).

<archetype e.g. 'two-bee-dialogue-meadow.recipe: the exact prompt shape / settings / reference set that landed
